en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Angie established a curfew at nighttime.
I wonder what will happen to training.

<CLT=cltMIND>I should go see what Kaito has to say
about this. I'm worried about him...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.
<CLT=cltMIND>But just seeing it makes me feel sick...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a normal bed.
It was pretty comfortable.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>Do they plan for us to wear this forever?
It makes it easier to tell us apart, I suppose...
